mainEntity.name: What is a fractional PR consultant and is it right for my startup?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional PR consultant is a senior communications operator who works inside your company part-time, running your media strategy the same way an in-house PR lead would, without the full-time salary or agency overhead. It is the right fit if you have a real news story, need tier-1 coverage, and want a senior person pitching editors directly rather than a $15K–$45K agency retainer funding a junior account team.

mainEntity.name: How much does a fractional PR consultant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator typically runs $5K–$12K/month depending on scope and cadence. A traditional full-service PR agency charges $15K–$45K/month because the retainer funds a multi-person account team. A focused launch sprint, covering four to eight weeks of intensive work around a specific moment, runs $15K–$40K as a fixed project.

mainEntity.name: What deliverables and outlets can I expect from a fractional PR consultant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deliverables typically include category positioning, a journalist and KOL map, press releases and pitch materials, embargo management, active media outreach and monthly coverage reporting. Outlets vary by news hook: tier-1 crypto (CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks), mainstream business (Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga) and regional APAC titles across Korea, Japan, China, India and SEA where the story warrants it.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from a fractional PR consultant?

acceptedAnswer.text: First placements typically appear within the first four to six weeks, once category positioning and the journalist map are built and a credible news hook is live. Tier-1 placements around a major moment such as a raise, mainnet or TGE can land within days when an embargo strategy is set up in advance. The highest-leverage work is the six to twelve weeks of positioning before your public moment, not the week of.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with a fractional PR consultant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your press footprint and narrative position. Or book a 30-minute call and we will map it live. No deck required, no account-team intro call.
